page.layout: Full-width heading block at the top: two lines of names with years at the right (1643, 1644). Below, a centred title in capitals with a two-line subtitle. Then one column of names with years set in a column at the right, divided by a vertical rule into three groups (1612, 1613, 1614), with horizontal rules between groups. "Curatores" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: Martinus Schoockius A. L. M. & Phil: Prof. | 1643
Samuel Maresius SS. Theol: D. & Prof. | 1644
priores ex urbe, cæteri quatuor ex agro. | 1612

page.notes: The years 1612, 1613 and 1614 stand in a column to the right, each beside its group, and are placed on the first line of their group. Long s has been read as a plain s throughout, so "Cof." is given as "Cos." and "Ienfema" as "Iensema". "postanus" is printed as shown and may be a misreading of "Poftanus". Show-through from the reverse and the digitiser's mark at the lower right are left out.
